title: Normalize one employee
problem: Workday sends Maya's name with extra spaces and an uppercase email. Produce one validated record without mutating the source.
concepts: Dictionary access, pure functions, validation, date parsing.
production_question: Explain whether an invalid row should reject a batch or enter quarantine.

title: Deduplicate recruiting deliveries
problem: EVT-0001 arrives twice, and the older delivery is last. Keep the newest source version per event ID.
concepts: Hash maps, aware timestamps, deterministic tie-breaking.
production_question: Explain replay safety and why arrival order is not source version order.

title: Write HR metric queries
problem: Start with current headcount per department; then turnover, funnel, and onboarding. Preserve the documented grain across joins.
concepts: GROUP BY, conditional aggregation, distinct grains, LEFT JOIN, zero denominators.
production_question: Explain which join can multiply the denominator and how to detect it.

title: Chunk policy sections
problem: A policy has two sections and a version. Split long sections without losing the exact citation location.
production_question: Explain why mixing versions or sections creates misleading citations.

title: Retrieve authorized evidence
problem: PTO v1 promises 120 hours; current v2 promises 160. Rank only current, permitted policy chunks in PostgreSQL.
production_question: Explain why filtering after retrieval changes both privacy and recall.

title: Ground answers and refuse
problem: A payroll answer needs an exact section and version. Unsupported or malicious requests must not become invented policy.
concepts: Typed output validation, evidence checks, uncertainty, prompt/data boundaries.
production_question: Explain a failure that keyword injection detection cannot prevent.

title: Authorize one operation
problem: Maya can read her own PTO. A manager role alone does not grant access to all employee records.
concepts: Deny by default, role scope, resource ownership.
production_question: Explain why a client-provided role or owner field cannot be trusted.

title: Implement employee and recruiting endpoints
problem: Expose employee details, job openings, candidate records, and aggregate metrics using the security matrix.
concepts: FastAPI dependencies, response models, parameter binding, HTTP errors.
production_question: Explain authorization before existence disclosure and response-field minimization.

title: Plan a safe tool call
problem: Employee needs help with payroll. Prepare a Payroll ticket plan; ambiguous PTO dates require clarification.
concepts: Allowlisted tools, structured arguments, validation, plan versus execution.
production_question: Explain why a model's selected tool is not permission to execute it.

title: Confirm and execute exactly once locally
problem: A double click must create one request. Bind confirmation to the actor, immutable proposal, expiry, and idempotency key.
concepts: Transactions, locks, unique constraints, payload hashing, explicit confirmation.
production_question: Explain the crash-after-external-send boundary and why this local guarantee differs.

title: Recover paginated source reads
problem: Page two times out twice before succeeding. Retry that page without losing or duplicating page one.
concepts: Bounded backoff, retry classification, cursor cycles, contract validation.
production_question: Explain retry storms, time budgets, and which failures must not be retried.

title: Ingest a batch atomically
problem: An update and a malformed employee arrive together. Preserve prior data when validation or database work fails.
concepts: Unit of work, source versions, upserts, rollback boundaries.
production_question: Explain recovery after process death and handling partial source snapshots.

title: Read prior request status
problem: Maya asks about TKT-001. Other employees must receive the same response for missing and unauthorized IDs.
concepts: Ownership checks, resource types, safe output schemas.
production_question: Explain how enumeration leaks information even without returning a record.
